utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Eli, the repair drive’s already buzzing—people are bringing lamps, bikes, even a wobbly chair, so if you’ve got anything to fix, Saturday morning’s the time to bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess—that helps, but I’d still like the exact start time and a simple repair list so folks know what to expect Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You’re right, Eli—I’ll double-check the exact start time and put together a simple list like lamps, bikes, small chairs, and other easy fixes so folks aren’t guessing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I’m sliding in late again—I’m covering the sign-up table for the first hour, so if you see the forms or the repair crew list, can you point me there?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, Dane—if I spot the forms or the repair crew list, I’ll point you right to them. I’m still waiting on confirmed details from Nell, so I won’t spread anything I’m not sure about yet.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik—I appreciate you keeping it solid until Nell confirms. I’ll hang near the table and start setting up whatever basics I can without guessing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Uli—I'm quietly checking in with folks today for Mina; do you know who's available to help with leaky roofs, broken steps, or heaters?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m not sure yet, Rey, but I can quietly ask during my sign-up shift and pass along anyone who mentions roofs, steps, or heaters.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli—that would help a lot. If you hear any names today, just tell me who can actually show up and which repair they’re comfortable with.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Opal, I only caught the basics—Leo said they need folks with screwdrivers or pliers for Saturday. Do you know what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have the start time pinned down yet, Bo, but I’ll check with Faye and add it to the supply-and-volunteer list with the screwdriver and plier needs.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Opal—just send me the time when you’ve got it, and I’ll see if I can swing by with pliers.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hana, Dane’s covering the sign-up table for the first hour, so I’m hoping you can help me point the small-appliance folks toward the right repair crews as they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds doable, Jules—before I start directing people, can you confirm which crews are handling small appliances and where each crew will be set up?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yep—small appliances go to Mira’s crew by the library tables for toasters and kettles, and Luis’s crew near the back outlets for lamps, fans, and anything that needs testing power.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Mara, I might be behind on this, but I think we still need to confirm who’s coordinating the tool list and sign-ups before I promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: You’re right to pause, Noah. I can check in with the group today and confirm who’s handling the tool list and sign-ups before either of us promises anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara—that’d help a lot. I’ll hold off on telling anyone specifics until you hear back from the group.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, I’m checking in from my errands—have you heard a confirmed time or seen a repair list for the drive yet?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Not a confirmed time yet, Ira, but Sam’s going to help sort the donated tools and keep the sharpening/parts list; I’ll bring my toolbox and spare drill set once we hear the final schedule.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Gus—that’s helpful. I’ll keep asking around for the final schedule and let Eli know Sam’s tracking the tools and parts list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Leo, I’m helping Gus sort the donated tools and track what needs sharpening or parts, so I’ll bring labels and a clipboard to keep things organized.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Sam — labels and a clipboard are perfect. Please mark anything dull or missing parts so we can set it aside Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Leo — I’ll mark the dull tools and anything missing parts, then set them aside clearly for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Mina, before we put out any request, I need the exact list of broken items and who’s officially collecting supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Pia, I’m waiting on Rey’s list today: leaky roofs, broken steps, and heaters first, plus who’s actually available. Until then, who do you have down as the official supply collector?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have anyone official yet, and I’d rather not name a collector until Rey’s list is in. Once we know the repairs and availability, we can pick one person clearly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Cleo, the repair drive is already picking up—if you’ve got lamps, bikes, or anything wobbly to fix, bring it by Saturday morning, and spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Quinn—I’ll spread the word and remind folks it’s Saturday morning, not the garden cleanup weekend. I’ll also check what spare parts and tools we’ve got on hand.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Cleo—thank you! And if anyone’s got a bike chain issue, tell them Marta’s nephew may be around to help.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oren, I’m trying to slot repair drive volunteers around school drop-off and pickup, so if you know who’s free in those windows, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh Faye, I think I can help—repair drive is this weekend, right? I’ll check my fridge note and ask around who’s free between drop-off and pickup, before I accidentally recruit folks for the garden cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren—that would be great. If you can send me just the drop-off and pickup-window names, I’ll match them with Opal’s supply list so we don’t double-book anyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Nell, I’m glad we’re checking in about the repair drive—are you thinking of helping with sign-ups, tools, or day-of coordination?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’d be happy to help with sign-ups, Rosa, but I should say I still don’t have the confirmed time and place—I only heard about it second-hand from Marisol.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for flagging that, Nell—I’ll confirm the time and place before putting you on the sign-up list, and I’ll check with Marisol so we’re not passing around guesses.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
